physical.material: Steel/SPCC backbone and cover, plastic fingers

configs.description: The finger duct as FS ships #220087, both covers fitted.
configs.name: base

gaps.note: no FS document held states a cable capacity for CMH-DFDS2U: the datasheet that covers it has no Cable Capacity Reference Guide, and the cable managers portfolio lists only dimensions. The product page could not be read (403 from the shop front).
gaps.wanted: the capacity row of the product page, or a capacity table in a later datasheet

gaps.note: the drawing draws the backbone of the dual duct only edge-on. Gallery image 3 of #220087 shows one light patch through it near the left end, which may be a pass-through hole like those of the single-sided part; no view gives its size, and the backbone is drawn solid.
gaps.wanted: a straight view of the backbone with a cover off
no bays and no grouped ports to correlate against, so there is nothing to wire yet - group the ports first - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
a port the DCIM export types as an interface - a placement in a group whose role is a port role, with media and speed it maps - unlocks interfaces on the NetBox / Nautobot device type

attrs.note: datasheet - style, sides, backbone and cover material, colour and the detachable cover are the specification table of the FS Horizontal Cable Managers with Finger Duct datasheet (steel, portal id 6867); RoHS and ISO 9001 its Standards Compliance list; the four screws and cage nuts are step 1 of the FS Horizontal Cable Managers quick start guide V1.0 for CMH-SFDS1U and CMH-DFDS2U.

backbone.note: drawing - the side view puts the backbone 117 from one cover (its dimension) and so 115 from the other; it is drawn centred, 115.4 + 1.2 + 115.4, 1.6 mm from the dimension, so that one finger part serves both channels.

backbone-holes.note: photo-measured - whether the backbone of the dual duct is pierced: the drawing draws it edge-on only, and gallery image 3 shows it dark through the open channel but for one light patch near the left end. Drawn solid; see the gap.

bottom.note: drawing - the bottom row of fingers is the top row again.

capacity.note: not stated - no capacity is carried: the steel finger duct datasheet has no capacity table and the cable managers portfolio gives dimensions only, so the figure is the `cable-capacity` gap below, not a datasheet fact.

chassis.note: drawing - THE BODY BETWEEN THE EARS. 482.6 over the ears, 465 between the hole centres; the cover and the duct between the ears read 537 px, 440.0. The ears, 20.5 each with three holes, are not drawn. Height 84.1 is the cover and the spec table, 103 px on both the front and the side view; the ears are 88 (2U). Depth 232 is the side view over both covers and the spec table.

color.note: estimated - Color: Black, drawn in the shades CMH-SFDS1U reads off its renders.

ears.note: drawing - `positions` states where the ears bolt, for the Rack Builder. The ears are on the backbone, which stands 116 mm from each cover (the side view, 232 over both covers, datasheet page 5; FS dimensions 117 from a cover edge to the backbone). `at` is 116, so the part spans the rail. This states a placement; no dimension changed.

fingers.note: drawing - ten fingers a row, the plan dimensioning 44.5 between the windows of two fingers and drawing the stems 54.3 px apart, 44.5; ten at that pitch run past the 440 cover, so 44.0 is taken and the row fills the body, as on CMH-SFDS1U. The moulding is the one CMH-SFDS1U carries: a 10.2 stem forking into two legs over a moulded block, a T head 39.4 wide. The fork is drawn as the stem.

front.note: drawing - the cover, fitted, as the front view draws it: 440 x 84.1 with four hinge clips, two on the top edge at 75.4 and 342.5 from the left end and two on the bottom below them. The finger rows are 9.0 thick, 4.7 in from the top and bottom of the cover, read off the side view (rails 4.9 to 13.9 and 70.5 to 80.3 from the top) and made symmetric. The `duct` guide is the 56.7 between the rows.

full-depth.note: `full-depth: false` - a dual-sided duct bolts to the front rails with its fingers facing both ways: it stands 116 mm to each side of its backbone (the side view, 232 over both covers), so it serves the face it is bolted to and the space just behind the rails, and at 232 mm it does not reach the rear rails of a rack. The rear face of its two rack units stays free for another part.

guides.note: drawing - one duct on each of the front and rear views, the channel between the finger rows, run across the rack.

left.note: drawing - the side view: two finger rows each side of the backbone, the covers at both ends. Both channels are open at the ends.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE VENDOR DRAWING. The FS Horizontal Cable Managers with Finger Duct datasheet (steel, portal id 6867) carries a technical drawing of CMH-DFDS2U: a plan, an isometric, the front and a side view. The embedded image (1437 x 779) is 1.2205 px/mm across the 482.6, 1.216 down the 88, 1.224 along the 232 and 1.225 down the 84.1 of the cover: orthographic, to about a millimetre. The renders of #220087 are the second reading; their backgrounds are transparent and were laid on white before measuring.

rear.note: drawing - the rear channel is the front channel turned round, as the plan draws it: the same fingers and an identical cover with its clips.

shell.note: drawing - A HOLLOW DUCT ON EACH SIDE. The body is a sheet body and its six views are elevations. The front view and the rear view each carry the backbone as a well 115.4 deep, whose floor is the backbone, the two rows of fingers standing in it and a cover that comes off; the two floors stand 1.2 apart, the gauge of the backbone. Both channels are open at their ends.

thickness.note: estimated - no FS document states the gauge. 1.2 is taken, the gauge of the other FS steel managers in the library.

top.note: drawing - the plan, rear cover at y=0: rear cover, heads, stems and blocks, the backbone at the middle, then the front channel to the front cover.

weight.note: datasheet - 2.08 kg, the FS product page specification for #220087, as read at intake; the datasheet states no weight.
